methodology: Offline packaged HTML, real Runtime/SaveSession/localStorage and existing mouse/touch controls. Save fixtures, player placement, quota and visibility gates are test-only. Fixed Date is used only for isolated rejection/layout/rollback cases, never the full 120-second training. Practice inputs and scene render are observed; original methods receive unchanged arguments exactly once. 390x844 is touch/viewport emulation, not a real phone. Full real-clock training also uses a 640x360 auxiliary viewport to reduce software rasterization cost, with a 540-second wall budget and unchanged 120 effective seconds/reward assertions. Old-build controls assert existing rendered behavior, not the absence of a new API.
